sum: The index uses an objective, rules-based methodology to provide exposure to small-capitalization U.S. companies with high free cash flow yields. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund's total assets (exclusive of collateral held from securities lending) will be invested in U.S.-listed small-capitalization equity securities that are the component securities of the index.
